data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**, but if you're based in Australia, I'd compare Stripe, Shopify Payments and Airwallex before making a decision.

The best option depends on three things\:

- How your online store is built.
- Where your customers are located.
- How much you're processing in sales each month.

## My top recommendations

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Excellent for WooCommerce and custom websites.
- Easy integrations and automated payments.
- Strong fraud prevention and reporting.
- Australian domestic card rate: approximately 1.7% + A\$0.30.

Best if you want flexibility and room to grow. [wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[support.stripe.com](https://support.stripe.com/questions/april-2024-pricing-update-for-businesses-on-standard-pricing-in-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Basic online domestic card rate: 1.75% + A\$0.30.

Best if your store already runs on Shopify. [www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex enters South Korean market with Paynuri acquisition](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D_4VHtA0SeOgicDFzw011KJjQsOKBcSueMkln4sAfXodLPEEa3t7NtMxla-fIF5UWu0iXuS_YfYtmjw0S_rQ80_HadZtbc68lQEKKReC4CqTEUwGZOTEsoS2QB_Jg1eQrkNfUqjqLxuL1E_IdkYV3XpPRgzm363kqM09FHLONA7S51LtpUhmis0bGr00iqMt?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Competitive domestic card fees: 1.65% + A\$0.30.
- International cards: 3.45% + A\$0.30.
- Multi-currency accounts and settlement.
- Integrations with ecommerce platforms.

Best if you sell internationally or want to manage multiple currencies. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Recognised and familiar to customers.
- Offers PayPal checkout and payment options.
- Easy to add to existing stores.
- Generally higher processing fees.

Best as an additional payment option rather than your only processor. [wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[support.stripe.com](https://support.stripe.com/questions/april-2024-pricing-update-for-businesses-on-standard-pricing-in-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[PayPal Business Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small Australian online store\:

| Situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| International customers | Airwallex |
| Customers who prefer PayPal | Add PayPal |


I'd generally start with one primary processor and add PayPal as an alternative checkout option.
